This script is used as a template for analyze your data with CellTFusion. The user needs to change the paths to specify the location of the following files: counts, traitData.

Set up environment
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("src/environment_set.R") #Load functions and packages
set.seed(123) #For reproducibility
```

Input data
```{r}
counts.norm.immucan = read.delim2("~/Downloads/all_cohorts_tpm_27112024.txt", row.names = 1)
rownames(counts.norm.immucan) <- str_replace(rownames(counts.norm.immucan), pattern = ".[0-9]+$", replacement = "")
counts.norm.immucan = convert_ensembl_symbol(counts.norm.immucan)
genes = rownames(counts.norm.immucan)
counts.norm.immucan <- data.frame(apply(counts.norm.immucan, 2, as.numeric))
rownames(counts.norm.immucan) = genes
```

CellTFusion
```{r}
res = CellTFusion(counts.nsclc2, normalized = F, cbsx.mail = "marcelo.hurtado@inserm.fr", cbsx.token = "734212f6ad77fc4eea2bdb502792f294", file_name = "IMMUCAN_NSCLC2")
counts.nsclc2 = counts.norm.immucan[,grep("NSCLC2\\.", colnames(counts.norm.immucan))]
deconv = compute.deconvolution(counts.nsclc, normalized = F, return = T, credentials.mail = "marcelo.hurtado@inserm.fr", credentials.token = "734212f6ad77fc4eea2bdb502792f294")
```
